description: This file contains pytest-based test cases for a FastAPI application. It tests various endpoints, including user routes, item routes, admin routes, and the root endpoint, focusing on authentication, authorization, and proper response handling.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports different app modules based on param, creates and returns a TestClient instance for testing.

methods.name: test_users_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /users endpoint with a token parameter 'jessica', expecting successful retrieval of user list.

methods.name: test_users_with_no_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /users endpoint without a token parameter, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_users_foo_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /users/foo endpoint with token 'jessica', expecting a specific user JSON response.

methods.name: test_users_foo_with_no_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /users/foo endpoint without a token, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_users_me_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /users/me endpoint with token 'jessica', expecting current user info.

methods.name: test_users_me_with_no_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /users/me endpoint without token, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_users_token_monica_with_no_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the /users endpoint with token 'monica', expecting error indicating no Jessica token.

methods.name: test_items_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items with token 'jessica' and header 'X-Token', expecting success with items.

methods.name: test_items_with_no_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items endpoint with header but no token, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_items_plumbus_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items/plumbus with token 'jessica', expecting item details.

methods.name: test_items_bar_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items/bar with token 'jessica', expecting item not found.

methods.name: test_items_plumbus_with_no_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items/plumbus with header but no token, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_items_with_invalid_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items with invalid token 'invalid', expecting header invalid error.

methods.name: test_items_bar_with_invalid_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items/bar with invalid token, expecting header invalid error.

methods.name: test_items_with_missing_x_token_header(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items with missing 'X-Token' header, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_items_plumbus_with_missing_x_token_header(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests /items/plumbus with missing 'X-Token' header, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_root_token_jessica(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests root endpoint with token 'jessica', expecting greeting message.

methods.name: test_root_with_no_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests root endpoint with no token, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_put_no_header(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests PUT /items/foo without headers, expecting missing token errors.

methods.name: test_put_invalid_header(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests PUT /items/foo with invalid 'X-Token' header, expecting header invalid.

methods.name: test_put(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests successful PUT to update item 'plumbus' with proper tokens.

methods.name: test_put_forbidden(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests PUT on '/items/bar' with 'plumbus' token, expecting operation forbidden.

methods.name: test_admin(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST /admin with proper tokens, expecting admin message.

methods.name: test_admin_invalid_header(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST /admin with invalid header, expecting header invalid error.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Retrieves and verifies the OpenAPI schema JSON for the FastAPI app.
